description: Find products matching a person's constraints. Put hard requirements in the filters (platform, max_price, free, no_subscription, attributes) and the rest in query. Each result says why it matched. Call list_attributes to see filterable keys.

free.description: Only products with a free offer

max_price.description: Most the cheapest way in may cost; 0 = free to start

no_subscription.description: Only products usable without a subscription

query.description: What the person wants, in their words
